clauses.title: Opening a billing dispute
clauses.text: I am writing about account AC-DEMO-05 with Cedar Vale Medical Center. The bill asks for $367.39. This review calculates $17.39 as the amount owed. The amount in dispute is $350.00. Please correct the charges below and send a revised statement.

clauses.title: Bill does not match the EOB
clauses.text: The bill for account AC-DEMO-05 does not match the patient responsibility on the explanation of benefits for claim CL-DEMO-05 from Harbor Synthetic Health. The amount in dispute is $350.00. Please change the bill so the patient balance matches that explanation of benefits, and send a corrected statement.

clauses.title: No Surprises Act balance
clauses.text: Account AC-DEMO-05 with Cedar Vale Medical Center shows a patient balance above the protected amount for claim CL-DEMO-05 (Harbor Synthetic Health). The amount in dispute is $350.00. Please reduce any patient balance above what the No Surprises Act allows for this service. If you believe a signed notice-and-consent form creates an exception, please include that form. Surprise-bill questions can go to the No Surprises Help Desk at 1-800-985-3059.

clauses.title: Hold collections
clauses.text: Please hold collections, late fees, and credit reporting on account AC-DEMO-05 while you review this letter. The amount in dispute is $350.00.
